question: What Do You Think About Nihilism?

answers.text: It's obviously like, easy to go numb.
But I think if we're here together as living, breathing organisms, we better live
and breathe as an ecosystem and try and figure that out
What is that? -the idea that nothing matters and everything is meaningless Oh, absolutely. I actually don't agree with that.
Everything matters because it's like, there's love. there's like connections, environment, like a lot of things matter
probably why I need a new house and job and I have no plans.
I feel like it's sad. I don't think I'm there yet.
I was a nihilist as a child.
It's funny because I work with kids now, and you can kind of see when a kid
is questioning things that aren't supposed to be questioned
and how annoying it is, and it's difficult to answer those questions. And I definitely faced the other side of that as a kid.
I consider myself like more of an absurdist now.
It's the language of perfect freedom. If nothing means anything. Why not just do it all?
It's part of life.
There’s a James Baldwin quote;
essentially the sentiment of it is that, we can't tell the children that there's no hope.
There has to be something to give the next generation hope to keep on doing the work that people have been doing for my generations and generations

I feel like nihilism is a good tool to have, so that you can be realistic about the extent to which things are fucked up. And like a lot of different ways and a lot of places, like, shit is really fucked up right now, and I think and I think it’s going to get a lot worse before it gets better But I do think it will get better. you know, like people will survive. People have survived a lot worse Shit
It's depressing.
I sometimes believed it
we need to understand at first what is most important for us. And if we find this,
nothing matters in the end, that's it.
Sometimes if you have a lot of things to do, [it will matter for you]
because you are a person, you are not a god
I absolutly 100% disagree with that
Yeah, I agree with him Everything he said
You just gotta make sure
we're all safe and feel comfortable,

I don't think that's a big issue.
I'm a pretty emotional guy. I don't know if I could devoid myself of all of those kinds of emotions I feel like it helps me understand the world.
Everything has a purpose, just like us right now.
Not for me, I do think there's a grander scheme to this things even if I might not feel it at the moment.
It kind of detracts from any thing you do that you think has a lot of value to you.
There's a timeline with like, every, like, big moment, every pivotal moment that's like set to happen in our lifetime. We just don't know it yet.
Things are what they are.
If I have no teeth, I can't go around saying I have teeth. It is what it is.
